"/home/node/uploads/" + files[0] : ""; })() }}

parameters.content:
## Video Summary backend
The Obsidian plugin posts a link, a pasted transcript or a file name to the **Webhook**. This workflow gets a transcript, asks the model for a note and answers with JSON.

- **Keys** live in the backend `.env`. The start script turns them into the credentials under **Overview → Credentials**; you do not paste keys here.
- **Something failed?** Open **Executions** at the top and the latest run. A model or key problem still shows Success there: open **AI: Write Note** in that run, its output says what went wrong.
- **Change the note style** in **AI: Write Note**. Updating the backend or changing keys imports the bundled workflow again, so keep your own version in `workflows/video-summary.json` in the backend folder.

Obsidian 插件把链接、文稿或文件名发到 Webhook；这里取得文稿、让模型写笔记，再把 JSON 交回去。出错时点上方 Executions 打开最近一次运行，看 AI: Write Note 的输出。

## Health check
The plugin's **Full check** lands here. It reports tools, versions and, on a deep check, whether the model and speech keys work.

## Cookies
Saves a cookies.txt the plugin sends (for Bilibili and other sites that need a login) into the backend `cookies/` folder.

## Local files
Files in the backend `uploads/` folder. Audio and video go to speech-to-text; PDFs are read as text; images go to the vision model.

## Pasted text
A transcript pasted in Obsidian skips downloading. A finished note sent back for reprocessing skips the model too.

## Video link
Tries the video's own subtitles first. Without subtitles it downloads the audio and sends it to speech-to-text.

## Video details
Title, author, length and cover from yt-dlp, added to the result.

## Write the note
**AI: Write Note** holds the prompt. If its reply is not valid JSON, **Code: Parse Note JSON** asks it again, up to three times; a wrong key or model name stops at once with a message.
